name: Sega Genesis / Mega Drive
_notes: Follows Genesis Plus GX (libretro) defaults as we understand them: RetroPad Y->A, B->B, A->C, L->X, X->Y, R->Z, Select->Mode. A/B/C run left to right across west/south/east. [VERIFY] against the current core. The fightpad-6 preset gives the physical two-row layout instead (X/Y/Z on west/north/r1, A/B/C on south/east/r2) for fighting games. default_controller is three_button because some 3-button-era games misread a 6-button pad; [VERIFY] what GPGX/EmuDeck default to. meta.confirm=C is a judgment call: Sega menus mostly take A/B/C/Start alike, and C on east matches the Nintendo-style confirm position. Also used for 32X and Sega CD; split out if their controller types diverge.
